ticker_news.title: S&P 500: Earnings Momentum Poised to Carry the Bull Run Into 2026
ticker_news.description: The S&P 500 earnings per share continue to beat expectations, with Q3 earnings on track to reach a new record high. The Magnificent-7 are leading market performance, driven by strong AI and cloud computing demand, with forward earnings projected to reach $350 per share by end of 2026.
ticker_news.author: Ed Yardeni

ticker_news.title: These 2 AI ETFs Are Ready to Crush the S&P 500 Over the Next 10 Years
ticker_news.description: The article discusses two AI-focused ETFs that offer different investment strategies: the Invesco QQQ ETF, which provides broad AI exposure through large-cap tech stocks, and the Ark Autonomous Technology & Robotics ETF, which focuses on unique AI and robotics opportunities with an actively managed approach.
ticker_news.author: Matt Frankel

ticker_news.title: Elevation Capital Advisory Loads Up Principal U.S. Mega-Cap ETF Shares in Q3
ticker_news.description: Elevation Capital Advisory initiated a new $8.7 million position in the Principal U.S. Mega-Cap ETF during Q3, representing 3.5% of its reported equity assets. The ETF focuses on tracking large U.S. mega-cap companies with concentrated holdings across technology, financial, and communication sectors.
ticker_news.author: Lawrence Rothman

SPY.title: US Stocks Face Two Short-Term Threats Amid Fed's Cautious Approach, Warn Analysts
SPY.description: Morgan Stanley analysts warn of two key risks for US stocks: the Federal Reserve's cautious interest rate policy and potential tariff impacts. Despite strong corporate earnings, market uncertainty remains about future monetary stance.
SPY.author: Namrata Sen
